[[Consulate Docks]] is the first mission in the [[Nightfall]] campaign for [[character]]s from other [[campaign]]s. You join the [[Order of the Sunspears|Sunspears]] as they assault [[Gandara, the Moon Fortress]] in an attempt to depose [[Varesh Ossa|Varesh]] and end her threat to [[Elona]]. Make sure you have [[Dunkoro]] in your party to enter.

==Mission information==

===Requirements===
* All party members must have accepted the reward for [[The Time is Nigh]].
* [[Dunkoro]] must be present in the party.

===Objectives===
Assault Gandara.
* Unite the western and southern attack fronts. 
* Capture the forward wall!
* ADDED: Defeat the [[Captain Lumanda|Kournan Gate Captain]] to prevent him from summoning Kournan troops.
* ADDED: Kill the siege engineers manning the [[firespitter]]s to clear the way for the southern attack front.
* ADDED: Capture the [[Bombard (Kournan)|Kournan bombard]] to gain entrance to the heart of Gandara.
* ADDED: Rally the attack force outside the [[Plaza of the Five Gods]].
* *[[Bonus|BONUS]]* Eliminate the [[Kournan Field Commander|Kournan field marshal]] groups.
* You have [3...0] of 3 Kournan field marshal groups remaining.

==Walkthrough==
For this mission only, all [[party]] members will be [[buff]]ed with [[Sunspear Battle Call]], which increases maximum health and armor (but not attribute points) to the equivalent of a level 20 [[character]]. An effect that helps low level characters/[[hero]]es to get through the mission more easily.

Leave the boat and start to attack. You will encounter several [[Kournan Bowman|Kournan Bowmen]], who tend to focus their arrows on one single [[target]], making them deadly to unprepared players. [[Spellcaster]] characters should try to attack them from behind walls to [[Line of sight|cover]] from their projectiles.

Once you've killed the archers, go down to the western gate guarded by [[Captain Lumanda]] who is able to call in reinforcements and get rid of him to prevent additional Kournan soldier spawns.

In the next area, your reinforcements will be obstructed by two [[firespitter]]s. Kill the Kournan Engineers and their groups to turn them off and reform the army by speaking to [[Nerashi]]. Make sure your allies do not remain stuck behind ground obstacles (or you will lose offense). 

Continue forward, killing Kournans to capture the bombard which can be used to breach the fortress. [[Captain Mwende]] and four Elite Kournans will be stationed behind the gate.

Climb the stairs to reach the Plaza of the Five Gods, where Varesh is trapped by the invasion to finish the mission.

===Bonus===
To gain the bonus rewards, your party has to kill three additional [[Kournan Field Commander]]s and their groups. These Commanders make use of a skill called [[Kournan Siege]], which deals massive damage and also interrupts actions.

# The first is near mission start, at the top left stairs and before Captain Lumanda.
# The second is situated past the Kournan bombard weapon and can be found after the cinematic but before Captain Mwende.
# The third and final is after Captain Mwende but before the Plaza of the Five Gods. Do not proceed to engage Varesh; instead, detour northeast to find them, otherwise you might accidentally finish the mission before you're able to complete the bonus.

{{bug|The first Field Commander may sometimes spawn beyond the closed gate. If you do not have any ranged spell attacks, you may need to restart the mission to get the Master's reward.}}

=== Hard mode ===
Avoid over-[[aggro]] especially around the main gate and third Field Commander.

===Skill recommendations===
* Skills that [[Stance#Skills countering stances|remove stances]], [[List of skills which bypass blocking|bypass blocking]] or [[List of blocking punishment skills|punish blocking]] to counter the [[Whirling Defense]] skill used by the [[Kournan Bowman|Kournan Bowmen]].
* Skills which [[Ranged attack#Skills that affect ranged attacks|defend against ranged attacks]] (e.g., [["Shields Up!"]]), or provide [[damage reduction]] over time (e.g., [[Shielding Hands]]).
* All foes are [[fleshy]], so there will be many [[corpse]]s for [[minion master]]s; Lonai is also a minion master.
* [[Enchantment]]-based [[build]]s are vulnerable to enchantment removal by [[Kournan Oppressor]]s and [[Kournan Seer|Seers]]. 
* [[List of hex removal skills|Hex removal skills]] could be unnecessary; the only [[hex spell]]s your party will encounter are [[Enchanter's Conundrum]] (the hex that is applied has no impact if your party does not use enchantments) and [[Life Siphon]] (ends when its caster dies).

==Notes==
[[Image:Consulate Docks Demons.jpg|thumb|The "Demon" group just before the cinematic.]]
* Kormir follows the [[party]] leader, never [[attacks]] and rarely uses [[skills]] except for [["Incoming!"]]. Foes cannot [[target]] her but she does take damage from [[area of effect]] skills.
*[[Firespitter]]s will kill allies immediately, but it does not count as a [[death]].
*As mentioned in the walkthrough, if you attempt to take the narrow passage between the firespitters and the wall, Nerashi, Rojis, and Lonai can become stuck and not follow you. This can be indicated by their names becoming gray in your Party Members list when you've run too far away. If this is the case, go back, regroup with them, and take the path around the wall.
*After this mission, nearly every single enemy has an [[elite skill]].
*After the completion of this mission for the first time, [[Koss]] will become unavailable until the completion of [[The Great Escape]] quest.
*After completing this mission, your party will be taken to [[Yohlon Haven]].
*Completion of this mission will fill in page #1 in the [[Night Falls]] [[storybook]].
